captions.detailed: A matte-black cylindrical air fryer featuring a main body with an open lower cavity, a top-mounted control tower, and a sliding basket drawer. The control tower is equipped with two vertically aligned rotary dials and a small rectangular push button on top. The basket drawer, complete with a prominent front handle and a bright red release button, slides smoothly in and out of the lower front cavity. The entire appliance is styled with a sleek, minimalist aesthetic suitable for a modern kitchen.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a cylindrical matte-black air fryer. It should include a main hollowed body, a top control tower with two rotatable dials and a top push button, and a sliding basket drawer with a handle containing a prismatic release button.
captions.factory: Construct the main body as a cylinder with a hollowed-out lower front cavity using boolean subtraction. Model the control tower as an extruded rounded rectangle on top of the body. Create the dials as small cylinders and the top button as a box, articulating them with continuous and prismatic joints. Build the basket drawer assembly with a front plate, internal basket container, and a rectangular handle with a red release button, and connect the drawer to the main body via a prismatic joint.
